matrix_normalization: divide each symmetrically assembled leading-Hessian matrix by its spectral 2-norm; report unscaled log-mass conversion using the source formula separately
eigenvalue_order: ascending source log10 mass; ties broken by ascending absolute eigenvalue, then original solver column index
sign_matching: positive, negative, and zeroish modes are compared in separate groups; a group cardinality mismatch is reported and never repaired by cross-sign matching

cluster_rule.quantity: dimensionless eigenvalue gap relative to the maximum of matrix spectral norm and the two absolute eigenvalues
cluster_rule.construction: sort eigenvalues by numeric value and join adjacent values when their normalized gap is at most threshold; connected components define clusters

coordinate_metric: all reported mass-basis eigenvectors are in the canonical whitened coordinates phi with theta=C*phi and C=inv(cholesky(K).L'); the canonical metric is G_phi=C'*K*C=I. If vectors are represented in theta coordinates, compare them with the K inner product and normalize each vector by sqrt(v'*K*v). Thus canonical Euclidean overlaps and theta-coordinate K-weighted overlaps are the same invariant quantity.

one_to_one_assignment.candidate_set: within each sign group, consider every bijection between the two mode sets; do not assign across signs
one_to_one_assignment.objective: maximize the sum of squared absolute metric-normalized overlaps; for canonical coordinates each overlap is abs(dot(u_left,u_right))
one_to_one_assignment.tie_break: among assignments whose objective differs from the maximum by at most tie_tolerance, choose the lexicographically smallest sequence of right-side source indices in ascending left-side source-index order

subspace_comparison: for equal-cardinality clusters of the same sign, compute singular values of U_left' * G * U_right using G=I in canonical coordinates or G=K in theta coordinates after metric normalization; report principal angles acos(clamp(sigma,0,1)); compare invariant subspaces without assigning individual vectors inside a cluster
individual_identity_withheld_when: either endpoint mode belongs to a cluster with more than one mode under cluster_rule
the best assignment objective is within tie_tolerance of a different assignment objective
the assigned absolute metric-normalized overlap is below 0.5
a same-sign group has different cardinality at the two endpoints
mode_comparison: outside clusters with unambiguous assignments, use the one_to_one_assignment; report signed log-mass deltas, assigned metric-normalized overlaps, and normalized eigenpair residuals
light_sector: report the span of the first three ascending-mass modes as a predeclared aggregate, with principal angles and projector distance; retain per-mode values only as ordered diagnostics
failure_policy: do not change thresholds, reorder across sign groups, or replace the declared rule after observing ladder results; emit unresolved/ambiguous matches when cardinality or cluster structure differs
quartic_matching: match self terms by mode index and mixed terms by the exact canonical index tuples returned by the API after any predeclared mode/subspace mapping; report basis-sensitive quartics as diagnostics and do not infer authority from them alone
